description: Guided DatoCMS setup: inspects the project, asks only what it can't infer, proposes a plan with prerequisites, and changes nothing until the user agrees. For setting DatoCMS up in a site or repo (previews and visual editing, caching, content rendering, SEO, search, CLI and migrations, releases, multi-project sync, webhooks, build triggers, WordPress or Contentful imports) or starting a new DatoCMS site. Use when the user wants something set up end to end or wants to be walked through it; a single, already-specified code change belongs to the owning DatoCMS skill.
